heading: Plan events with us!
body: Are you interested in event hosting, planning, hospitality, venue relations/promotion, or marketing? Regardless of experience, we'd love to hear from you!

ambassador.heading: Become a DSC Brand Ambassador
ambassador.body: Ambassadors represent DSC at events and online. They welcome the people who came alone, share the nights with their networks, and help set the tone of the room.

work.heading: Work with us
work.body: We sell out venues. Wineries, barns, hotel ballrooms, marinas, a few hundred young professionals a night, on a weeknight or a Saturday. If you run a venue, a bar, or a restaurant with room to dance and you want a full house, we bring the crowd, the band, the lesson, and the promotion. You bring the room.

music.heading: Play our events
music.body: Live bands and DJs are the center of every night. If you play swing, country, Latin, jazz, or big band, we'd like to hear you.

sponsor.heading: Sponsor an event
sponsor.body: Our nights put a few hundred young professionals in one room. Sponsors get their name on the night, on the site, and in front of a crowd that goes out, spends, and talks. Venues, restaurants, and local businesses do well here.

donate.heading: Donate
donate.body: Ticket sales cover the nights. Gifts cover everything between them, the free lessons, the outreach, and the new venues we try.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.body: We are growing the young adult scene in DC, MD, and VA one event at a time. Contact us to learn more about our mission and work, or to become involved yourself.
